chunks: From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Zur'ah, from Abu Basir, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): 'Does the fasting person kiss?' He said: 'Yes, and he gives it to his tongue so it sucks it.'
ai.seo_question: Does kissing nullify the fast in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the fiqh of intimacy during fasting, permitting kissing but specifying that the spouse should kiss the tongue to facilitate the sucking of saliva rather than swallowing it. This detail highlights the scholarly distinction between 'swallowing saliva' (which breaks the fast) and merely tasting or absorbing it, reflecting the practical nuances of Shia jurisprudence regarding minor acts that do not nullify the fast.
